"""rcb_dtb — DexToolBench (SimToolReal) tasks in plain MuJoCo for robot_coding_bench.

Scene = SimToolReal's MuJoCo sim2sim scene (github.com/tylerlum/simtoolreal, MIT, deployment/mujoco/mujoco_sim.py),
rebuilt here without its training stack: KUKA iiwa 14 (MuJoCo Menagerie) + left Sharpa HA4 hand attached at the iiwa
flange, a 0.475 x 0.4 x 0.3 m table (top at z = 0.53 m), the tool (convex-decomposed meshes) and a green goal marker
(no contacts). Physics 600 Hz (implicitfast, elliptic cones, multi-CCD, gravity-compensated robot), control 60 Hz.

A task = one DexToolBench demo: a tool start pose and a sequence of goal poses (world frame). The benchmark's rule:
the current goal counts as reached when all 8 keypoints of the tool's grasp box (0.141 x 0.03025 x 0.0271 m, scaled
by 1.5) are within 1.5 cm of the same keypoints at the goal pose; then the next goal becomes current. Each goal has
10 s (600 control steps); a goal not reached in time ends the attempt. progress = goals reached / number of goals.

trajectory = (T, 29) joint position targets, one row per control step (1/60 s), each held for 10 physics steps:
7 iiwa joints then the 22 Sharpa joints (names: JOINT_NAMES). Replaying it from the frozen start state is bit-exact.

import numpy as np
import mujoco
import rcb_dtb
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from PIL import Image
import argparse, json, time

class Controller:
 def __init__(self):
  self.s=rcb_dtb.Session(); self.m=self.s.model; self.d=self.s.data
  self.k=mujoco.MjData(self.m); self.pid=self.m.body('palmworld').id; self.oid=self.m.body('object').id
  self.q=rcb_dtb.INIT_Q.copy(); self.s.record_start()
 def palm(self): return self.d.xpos[self.pid].copy(),self.d.xmat[self.pid].reshape(3,3).copy()
 def obj(self): return self.d.xpos[self.oid].copy(),self.d.xmat[self.oid].reshape(3,3).copy()
 def ik(self,pos,R,q=None):
  q=self.q.copy() if q is None else q.copy()
  for it in range(100):
   self.k.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos; self.k.qpos[self.s._jq]=q; mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.m,self.k); mujoco.mj_comPos(self.m,self.k)
   p=self.k.xpos[self.pid]; r=self.k.xmat[self.pid].reshape(3,3)
   err=np.r_[pos-p,Rot.from_matrix(R@r.T).as_rotvec()]
   if np.linalg.norm(err)<1e-6: break
   jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv)); jr=jp.copy(); mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m,self.k,jp,jr,self.pid)
   j=np.vstack([jp[:,self.s._jv[:7]],jr[:,self.s._jv[:7]]]); dq=j.T@np.linalg.solve(j@j.T+np.eye(6)*1e-6,err)
   dq*=min(1,.15/(np.max(np.abs(dq))+1e-12)); q[:7]=np.clip(q[:7]+dq,self.s.lower[:7]+.001,self.s.upper[:7]-.001)
  return q
 def step(self,q):
  self.q=q.copy(); return self.s.step(q)
 def jointmove(self,q,n=120):
  start=self.q.copy()
  for t in range(n):
   f=(t+1)/n; f=f*f*(3-2*f); self.step(start+(q-start)*f)
 def move(self,pos,R=None,n=120,hand=None):
  p0,r0=self.palm(); R=r0 if R is None else R; rv=Rot.from_matrix(R@r0.T).as_rotvec(); h0=self.q[7:].copy()
  for t in range(n):
   f=(t+1)/n; f=f*f*(3-2*f)
   q=self.ik(p0+f*(pos-p0),Rot.from_rotvec(f*rv).as_matrix()@r0)
   if hand is not None: q[7:]=h0+(hand-h0)*f
   self.step(q)
 def hold(self,n=60):
  for t in range(n):self.step(self.q)
 def snap(self,name):
  Image.fromarray(self.s.render_grid(size=(640,480))).save('/app/output/'+name+'.png')
  print(name,'step',self.s.steps,'progress',self.s.progress(),'object',self.obj()[0],'palm',self.palm()[0],flush=True)
 def contacts(self):
  cs=[]
  for c in self.d.contact:
   b1=self.m.geom_bodyid[c.geom1]; b2=self.m.geom_bodyid[c.geom2]
   if self.oid in [b1,b2]:
    force=np.zeros(6);mujoco.mj_contactForce(self.m,self.d,c.id if hasattr(c,'id') else 0,force)
    cs.append((self.m.body(b1).name,self.m.body(b2).name,c.dist,c.pos.copy()))
  print(cs,flush=True)

def trial(args):
 c=Controller(); c.hold(60); p,R=c.palm(); op,oR=c.obj()
 R=Rot.from_euler('z',.07).as_matrix()@Rot.from_euler('x',-.1092).as_matrix()@R
 p=np.array([op[0],args.y,args.z]); c.move(p+np.array([0,0,.04]),R,120)
 c.move(p,R,120); c.snap('approach')
 hand=np.zeros(22); hand[:5]=[args.thumb,0,.4,0,.8]
 for i in [5,9,13,18]:hand[i:i+4]=[args.mcp,0,args.pip,args.dip]
 hand[17]=0
 q=c.q.copy(); q[7:]=hand; c.jointmove(q,150);c.hold(60);c.snap('closed');c.contacts()
 c.move(c.palm()[0]+[0,0,.12],n=240);c.hold(120);c.snap('lift');c.contacts()
 A=c.s.record_stop();c.s.save_trajectory(A,'/app/output/trial.npz')
 np.savez('/app/output/trial_state.npz',q=c.q,object_pos=c.obj()[0],object_mat=c.obj()[1],palm_pos=c.palm()[0],palm_mat=c.palm()[1])
 if c.s._renderer:c.s._renderer.close()
if __name__=='__main__':
 a=argparse.ArgumentParser();a.add_argument('--y',type=float,default=.20);a.add_argument('--z',type=float,default=.655);a.add_argument('--mcp',type=float,default=.65);a.add_argument('--pip',type=float,default=1.5);a.add_argument('--dip',type=float,default=1.2);a.add_argument('--thumb',type=float,default=1.4)
 trial(a.parse_args())
PY

 for t in range(20000):

  gi=c.s.goal_index; g=np.array(c.s.goals[gi]); op,oR=c.obj()
  dp=g[:3]-op; dr=Rot.from_quat(g[3:]).as_matrix()@oR.T; dr=Rot.from_matrix(dr).as_rotvec()
  dp*=min(.06,.001/(np.linalg.norm(dp)+1e-10)); dr*=min(.04,.007/(np.linalg.norm(dr)+1e-10))
  jp=np.zeros((3,c.m.nv));jr=jp.copy();mujoco.mj_jac(c.m,c.d,jp,jr,op,c.pid)
  J=np.vstack([jp[:,:7],jr[:,:7]*.15]); e=np.r_[dp,dr*.15]
  dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*1e-5,e)
  dq*=min(1,.012/(np.max(np.abs(dq))+1e-10));q=c.q.copy();q[:7]+=dq
  q=np.clip(q,c.s.lower,c.s.upper); c.step(q)
  if t%100==0:print('servo',t,c.s.progress(),'obj',op,flush=True)
  if c.s.goal_index!=gi:c.snap('goal_%02d'%c.s.goal_index)
 c.snap('final')
 A=c.s.record_stop();c.s.save_trajectory(A,'/app/output/trajectory.npz')
 print('REPLAY',c.s.replay(A),flush=True)""")
